title: Claude Announces Major Merger: Becomes the Single Entry Point, Directly Competes with Microsoft
excerpt: Anthropic recently officially announced that it has fully integrated its previously independent Claude Cowork and Chat modules into a new unified version of Cla
content_html:
Anthropic recently officially announced that it has fully integrated its previously independent Claude Cowork and Chat modules into a new unified version of Claude. This upgrade seamlessly integrates all-round capabilities such as Cowork, Design, Docs, and Slides into a single application, completely solving the pain point of users struggling with multiple entry points when handling multiple tasks. At the same time, it fully retains users' original conversation history, various Skills, and connector configurations. It is reported that this new version will be rolled out to Pro and Max subscribers first in the coming weeks.

In terms of interaction experience and product logic, the new version of Claude has achieved a revolutionary shift from the traditional "response window" to a "result space." Users no longer need to manually switch through complicated tool menus; the model can automatically determine and call the corresponding underlying capabilities based on the complexity of the task, and also supports advancing complex composite tasks in the background. This means that users can directly complete the entire process of document drafting, slide creation, and visual design by simply issuing instructions in the chat input box. All generated content will remain in the same contextual environment and support editing, annotation, export, and sharing at any time.

From a deeper industry trend perspective, this product architecture adjustment reflects the strategic shift of global AI giants in the competition for operating system access points. Whether it's OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google, their core competitive logic is undergoing significant changes — instead of letting users get lost in a variety of function options, they are absorbing complexity through powerful AI agents (Agents), allowing users to directly obtain final results within a minimalistic interface. As Anthropic launches a unified "office suite," a new round of competition for productivity access points in the AI era is becoming increasingly intense.
